sources.locator: Main page cards: h2#faculty 'Faculty' (40 cards) and h2#joint 'Joint Faculty' (8 cards); h3 name and p.about title
Tables captioned 'ECE Adjuncts' (7 rows), 'ECE Emeritus' (27 rows; name, title, email), 'ECE Contacts' (12 rows; 'Last, First, Role')
Profile header 'Holcombe Endowed Chair', 'ECE Department Chair'; professional experience: joined as Samuel Lewis Bell Distinguished Professor of ECE

findings.description: Both brief lists downloaded with exact URLs (faculty and tables). Response bytes are identical (SHA-256 46decf360f07b4cd9d1e715913629b51369ce895cf00ac9bd83f89c0e3a268ae), so one hash covers both; retrieved 2026-11-25T02:11:43Z and 02:11:44Z, after brief.created_at 2026-11-25T02:10:04Z.

Enumerated the full page: 40 Faculty cards, 8 Joint Faculty cards, 7 ECE Adjuncts rows, 27 ECE Emeritus rows, 12 ECE Contacts rows = 94 entries. All 94 match brief.people by name (honorific/comma normalization only); no omissions and no people in the brief missing from the page. No research-faculty or professors-of-practice section exists on the page (the dropdown anchor #research has no target).

Profile fetch: only Hai Xiao's profile link was fetchable and was checked (curl exit 0, SHA-256 6ce4f579b135214ff406874bc999c91a6370b71475ae3f94d7a9947a80f92b5f). Other profile links were not fetched (optional).

Two different people share the surname Ballato and are kept separate: John Ballato (Joint Faculty, PROFESSOR, joint_secondary) and Art Ballato (ECE Adjuncts, Adjunct Professor, adjunct). The page does not state they are the same person, so no merge was made.

Outcome counts: included 41 (34 regular from the Faculty section, 7 joint_secondary from the Joint Faculty section); excluded 53 (26 emeritus, 13 academic_professional incl. 12 ECE staff and 1 Professor of Practice, 7 adjunct, 4 teaching incl. Kevin McKenzie in Joint, 3 visiting). No incoming appointments announced on the page; no explicit start dates, so effective_from_json is null throughout.

Behnaz Papari: listed in the ECE main Faculty section as ASSISTANT PROFESSOR, but her linked profile sits under the Automotive Engineering site. Included regular on the ECE main-list designation (policy: main-list professorial rank = regular). Would change to excluded or joint_secondary only if the ECE listing were shown to be non-official.

Hai Xiao: card title is only 'DEPARTMENT CHAIR'. Regular included based on the official ECE profile stating a professorial appointment (Samuel Lewis Bell Distinguished Professor of ECE) with the department chair role. Would change only if the profile's professorial appointment were withdrawn.

Randy Collins: borderline. Row title is 'Professor' (no emeritus wording) but the row sits under the ECE Emeritus heading and not on the main Faculty list. Decided emeritus (past) by source precedence (specific appointment type over generic title). Would change to regular (or a category by the school's confirmed active appointment) only if the school confirms an active professorial appointment in ECE.

Todd Marek: listed under the ECE Emeritus table but the row title is 'Professor of Practice'. Decided academic_professional per the practice-track rule. Current state recorded not_in_core because the title is active, not former.

Michael Pursley: borderline. Row title is 'Professor, Holcombe Chair' (no emeritus wording) but the row sits under the ECE Emeritus heading and not on the main Faculty list. Decided emeritus (past) by source precedence (specific appointment type over generic title). Would change to regular (or a category by the school's confirmed active appointment) only if the school confirms an active professorial appointment in ECE.

Robert Schalkoff: borderline. Row title is 'Professor' (no emeritus wording) but the row sits under the ECE Emeritus heading and not on the main Faculty list.
